newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico crude oil ports closed due to bad weather.
newsitem.headline: Mexico crude oil ports closed due to bad weather.

text.p: Three of Mexico's main crude oil shipping ports remained closed early on Sunday due to bad weather, the Ministry of Communications and Transport said.
In total, five ports were closed, it said.
The closed ports are Coatzacoalcos, Dos Bocas, Cayo Arcas, Ciudad del Carmen and Campeche.

The three main crude oil ports - Dos Bocas, Pajaritos (part of Coatzacoalcos), and Cayo Arcas - are used by state-owned oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) to load and ship crude to the United States and Europe from Gulf of Mexico fields.
